NONE: › A pliable substance bends easily without breaking or cracking.
（物質）易彎的，柔韌的
› often disapproving A pliable person is easily influenced and controlled by other people.
（人）易受影響的，順從的

example: Some kinds of plastic become pliable if they're heated.
有些塑膠遇熱會變軟。
He wanted a sweet, pliable, obedient wife.
他想找一個溫柔、聽話、順從的妻子。

NONE: › Pliant people are easily influenced or controlled by other people.
（人）易受影響的，順從的
› being able and willing to accept change or new ideas
善於變通的，能合乎時宜的，順勢應變的
› able to bend easily without breaking
（物質）易彎的，柔韌的

example: I don't think it's a good thing for children to be too pliant.
我認為孩子太聽話了並不是件好事。
The management has adopted a more pliant position, and has agreed to listen to the staff's requests.
管理階層採取了更靈活的立場，同意聽取員工的要求。
These toys are made of pliant rubber, so they won't break.
這些玩具由柔韌橡膠製成，所以不會被弄壞。

C: › [ C ] plural plicae or plicas a fold or ridge in the skin
U: › [ U ] also plica plonica very dirty hair that is twisted into firm, tangled masses

example: Plica Syndrome occurs when the plica becomes irritated or inflamed.
當皺襞變得發紅或發炎時，就出現了皺襞症候群。

NONE: › a small tool with two handles for holding or pulling small things like nails, or for cutting wire
老虎鉗，鉗子

example: Pass me that pair of pliers, please.
請把那把老虎鉗子遞給我好嗎？

NONE: C2 an unpleasant condition, especially a serious, sad, or difficult one
困境，窘境

example: the plight of the poor/homeless
窮人／無家可歸者的困難處境
Few of us can be unmoved by the plight of the refugees.
我們幾乎無一不為難民的困難處境而心有所感。

NONE: › a flat, light shoe made of heavy cloth with a rubber sole, worn especially for sports
橡膠底帆布鞋，體操鞋
› a line painted on the outside of a ship that shows how deep it is legally allowed to go down into the water when it is full
（船）載重吃水線
› a square block, especially of stone, on which a column or a statue stands
（柱子或雕像的）底座，柱基
› from or referring to the period of time between around 5.3 million and 1.8 million years ago, in which many modern mammals and the first modern humans appeared
上新世的（迄今約530萬至180萬年前的地質時間段，其間許多現代哺乳動物和現代人祖先開始出現）

example: the Pliocene epoch
上新世時代
